changeSet.author: claude (P4-14)
changeSet.comment: Whether the publisher has accepted the marketplace terms (P4-14), copied from ms_user's user.profile.updated. Browse shows a listing only when its publisher has a display name AND has accepted: the marketplace is opt-in, and withdrawing hides the user's listings without deleting anything. DEFAULT false fills existing rows as not accepted, so every current listing is hidden until its publisher accepts the terms - intended. An event without the field (published before P4-14) leaves the held value alone.
